files.description: Planned fare changes (30 rows, one per affected station): station_code (refers to stations.csv; four digits with leading zeros), effective_from (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD), new_base_fare (two decimals; about 3% empty).

task_text: In fare_changes.csv, convert new_base_fare into whole cents (1.50 becomes 150), keeping empty values empty. `result` should be a Series of cents indexed by station_code (text, leading zeros kept), in file order.
intended_computation: Read fare_changes.csv keeping station_code as text; new_base_fare in whole cents (1.50 -> 150), missing where empty; a Series indexed by station_code in file order.

acceptable_variants.notes: id columns (rider_id, station codes) may be written as integers without leading zeros; cents may be float or a nullable integer
